description: Send an SMS message from one of your provisioned Canadian numbers. Checks CASL consent for every send, transactional or commercial (CRTC DNCL checking is coming soon and not yet enforced); skip_consent_check turns the check off on a test-mode key only, and a live key gets 403 FORBIDDEN. Billed per SMS part as the carrier splits the body (get_pricing → message_cost_cents; typographic quotes and dashes count as GSM-7, emoji force Unicode parts); the charge is settled to the carrier's part count after the send. A send the carrier rejects outright costs nothing; a message the carrier accepts but cannot deliver keeps its charge. A send to a reserved exchange (555-XXXX, N11 exchanges, carrier test codes) is refused for free as 422 RESERVED_DESTINATION, in test mode too. A number the carrier has failed three times running, for any customer, is refused for free as 422 UNDELIVERABLE_NUMBER for 90 days. A test-mode key (mk_test_...) simulates a send: it runs the same compliance checks as a live send (consent, opt-out, allow/deny lists, reserved and undeliverable destinations) but does not require owning the from number, and nothing is sent or charged. A test-mode send still returns status "DELIVERED": the "mode" field, not the status, tells a simulation from a real send. Live sends are subject to sending limits (get_send_limit): a daily cap, a cap on identical messages to distinct recipients, a per-number rate (the carrier sends 10 message parts a minute from a local number, so a send is refused with NUMBER_RATE_LIMITED and details.retry_after_seconds while a minute of parts is already waiting), a per-recipient cap (30 an hour and 100 a day to one number), and an automatic pause on high opt-out or failure rates: refusals come back as DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED, FANOUT_LIMIT_REACHED, NUMBER_RATE_LIMITED, RECIPIENT_RATE_LIMITED or SENDING_PAUSED with details. Link shorteners (bit.ly and similar) are refused in both modes (LINK_SHORTENER_BLOCKED); full URLs are accepted. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the original message instead of sending and charging again. A 503 CARRIER_UNAVAILABLE means the carrier could not be reached: nothing was sent or charged, and a retry shortly after is safe. A 503 CARRIER_THROTTLED means the carrier asked us to slow down and did not take the message: nothing was charged; retry after details.retry_after_seconds with the same idempotency_key. A message that later shows FAILED with error_code CARRIER_THROTTLED was dropped from a full queue after the carrier took it and is refunded: resend it with a new idempotency_key. A live send answers estimated_send_at, an estimate of when the carrier will send it given the parts already waiting on that number. A 503 CARRIER_TIMEOUT means the carrier did not answer in time: the message may or may not have been sent and nothing is charged; list_messages shows whether it went out. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the failed message instead of sending it again. A 422 NOT_A_MOBILE_NUMBER means the destination is a landline or VoIP number: the carrier refuses it before sending, nothing is charged, and three such refusals list the number as undeliverable. A 422 NON_CANADIAN_NUMBER means the recipient is not a Canadian number, and a 422 INVALID_PHONE_NUMBER means the carrier found the number invalid; neither costs anything.

body.description: Message body text. Maximum 1600 characters and 10 SMS parts (about 1,530 GSM-7 or 670 Unicode characters); a longer body is rejected with 422 MESSAGE_TOO_LONG before anything is charged. Billing is per part, counted the way the carrier splits it.

dncl_exemptions.description: DNCL exemption reasons. Required if the recipient is on the CRTC Do Not Call List.

from.description: Sending phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14376660100). On a live key it must be an active number on your account; on a test key any valid NANP number works, since nothing is sent.

idempotency_key.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header. A retry with the same key can never become a second send or a second charge.

skip_consent_check.description: Skip the CASL consent gate. Test-mode keys only: a live key gets 403 FORBIDDEN. For consent recorded outside HonkIO.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format. Must be a Canadian number.
